title: A joint resolution providing for the appointment of Michael Govan as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This joint resolution appoints Michael Govan as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress approved appointing Michael Govan as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution names Michael Govan to serve as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents, which oversees the Smithsonian Institution. Citizen regents are private individuals chosen to help guide the Smithsonian, rather than government officials. The summary provided does not describe any terms, duties beyond board service, or funding changes.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on April 19, 2017.
